item.title: k8s: Kubernetes v1.37: Pod Certificates and Cluster Trust Bundles
item.description:
Kubernetes 1.37 graduates Pod Certificates and Cluster Trust Bundles to GA, adding built-in support for workload X.509 identity and trust bundle distribution. The feature uses Kubelet, PodCertificateRequest objects, and signer controllers to issue and rotate certificates for TLS/mTLS while keeping key material on the node filesystem.

  • Source: Kubernetes Official Blog

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Front Door mutual TLS
item.description:
Azure Front Door now supports mutual TLS in public preview. It lets Front Door authenticate clients with X.509 certificates before forwarding requests to the application.

  • Source: Azure Updates
